comment: Flow style collections are not supported (yet)
name: Grammar for Jinja2 expressions in Ansible conditionals

patterns.begin:
(?x)
                            ^(\s*) # 1
                            (?:(-)(\s+))? # 2, 3; in case it is first key of a list item
                            \b( # 4
                                changed_when
                                | failed_when
                                | when
                                | check_mode
                                | until
                            )\b
                            \s* (:) # 5
                            (?=\s) (?!\s*[|>'"]|\s*$|\s*\#.*$) # starting an unquoted flow
patterns.end:
(?x)
                            ^(?!\1\3\3\s+) # if the indentation is too small; HACK: \3 is used twice to match at least 2 spaces if group 2 matches
patterns.name: meta.flow-unquoted.ansible.condition

patterns.begin:
(?x)
                            ^(\s*) # 1
                            (?:(-)(\s+))? # 2, 3; in case it is first key of a list item
                            \b( # 4
                                changed_when
                                | failed_when
                                | when
                                | check_mode
                                | until
                            )\b
                            \s* (:) # 5
                            (?=\s) (?!\s*[|>]|\s*$|\s*\#.*$) # not starting a block (scalar or other)
patterns.end:
(?x)
                            ^(?!\1\3\3\s+) # if the indentation is too small; HACK: \3 is used twice to match at least 2 spaces if group 2 matches
patterns.name: meta.flow.ansible.condition

patterns.begin:
(?x)
                            ^(\s*) # 1
                            (?:(-)(\s+))? # 2, 3; in case it is first key of a list item
                            \b( # 4
                                changed_when
                                | failed_when
                                | when
                                | check_mode
                                | until
                            )\b
                            \s* (:) # 5
                            \s+ (?: (\|) | (>) ) ([1-9])? ([-+])? # 6,7,8,9; starting a scalar block
                            (.*$) # comment or illegal
patterns.end:
(?x)
                            ^(?!\1\3\3\s+) # if the indentation is too small; HACK: \3 is used twice to match at least 2 spaces if group 2 matches
patterns.name: meta.block-scalar.ansible.condition

patterns.begin:
(?x)
                            ^(\s*) # 1
                            (?:(-)(\s+))? # 2, 3; in case it is first key of a list item
                            \b( # 4
                                changed_when
                                | failed_when
                                | when
                                | check_mode
                                | until
                            )\b
                            \s* (:) # 5
                            (.*$) # comment or illegal
patterns.end:
(?x)
                            ^(?!\1\3\3\s+) # if the indentation is too small; HACK: \3 is used twice to match at least 2 spaces if group 2 matches
patterns.name: meta.block.ansible.condition

patterns.end:
(?x)
                            (?!\G) # otherwise match is found immediately
                            ^(?!\1\s+) # if the indentation is too small
patterns.name: meta.yaml-block.ansible.condition

patterns.end:
(?x)
                            ^(?!\1\3\s+) # if the indentation is too small
patterns.name: meta.yaml-block-list-item.ansible.condition

patterns.end:
(?x)
                            (") # 1; match the starting quote
                            (?: (?=\s+\#) | (.*$) ) # 2; unless it is a comment anything trailing here is illegal
patterns.name: string.quoted.double.ansible.meta

patterns.end:
(?x)
                            ^(?!\1\s+) # if the indentation is too small
patterns.name: meta.yaml-scalar-block.ansible.condition

patterns.end:
(?x)
                            ('(?!')) # 1; match the starting quote
                            (?: (?=\s+\#) | (.*$) ) # 2; unless it is a comment anything trailing here is illegal
patterns.name: string.quoted.single.ansible.meta

patterns.comment: Capture any non-whitespace and end as fast as possible (when inner pattern ends)
patterns.name: string.unquoted.ansible

patterns.comment: Capture any non-whitespace at the beginning of a block
patterns.end:
(?x)
                            ^(?!\1\s*) # if the indentation is too small
patterns.name: string.unquoted-block.ansible
